name: Bitcoin Cycle Workbench Research MCP
description: Machine-readable Bitcoin cycle research, on-chain context, macro/video insight summaries, and educational signal explanations for OpenClaw/MCP-capable agents. Not financial advice.

resources_preview.name: demo_workbench_data
resources_preview.description: Current static/demo workbench data structure. Live public price/candle data is fetched client-side until backend deployment.

resources_preview.name: research_catalog
resources_preview.description: Catalog of available/planned research feeds, cycle metrics, and action-oriented insight products.

tools_planned.name: get_cycle_posture
tools_planned.description: Return current educational cycle posture with source labels and uncertainty notes.

tools_planned.name: get_actionable_research_insights
tools_planned.description: Return structured, source-linked insights extracted from Bitcoin/macro/on-chain videos and research notes.

tools_planned.name: compare_cycle_indicators
tools_planned.description: Compare indicators such as MVRV, Puell, Pi Cycle, realized price, HODL waves, and fee pressure.

tools_planned.name: explain_metric_relevance
tools_planned.description: Explain why a chart or metric matters, its limitations, and what timeframe it covers.

payments_planned.free_tier: public demo, basic manifest, and limited educational samples
payments_planned.paid_tier_idea: per-call micropayments for fresh actionable insight bundles, deeper transcript synthesis, and source-linked cycle reports
payments_planned.note: Payment-gated endpoints are not active yet. No custody, no trade execution, no financial advice.

safety.intended_use: research context, educational explanations, and agent-readable synthesis
safety.disclaimer: Agents should not treat this as investment advice. Outputs are research signals with uncertainty and source labels.
